tool_description: OCTCube-M is a 3D multimodal optical coherence tomography foundation model for retinal and systemic diseases with cross-cohort and cross-device validation. It provides multi-task classification for 8 retinal diseases: AMD, DME, Glaucoma, DR, ERM, VD, CRV/AO, and RNV. The tool supports screening, classification, and disease prediction with confidence scores.

input.description: Path to the input OCT volume file (.npy, .nii.gz) or directory containing OCT data.

output.description: Directory path where the classification results will be saved.

task.description: Type of analysis to perform on the OCT volume.

diseases.description: Specific diseases to analyze. If not specified, all 8 diseases will be analyzed.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum confidence threshold for positive disease classification.

export_probabilities.description: Export raw probability scores for all disease classes.

visualization.description: Generate visualization of attention maps and prediction results.

batch_processing.description: Process multiple OCT volumes in batch mode.

classification_results.description: Path to the JSON file containing disease classification results with confidence scores.

probability_scores.description: Path to the file containing raw probability scores for all disease classes.

visualization_files.description: List of file paths to generated attention maps and visualization images.

summary_report.description: Path to the summary report containing screening results and recommendations.

processing_log.description: Path to the processing log file with analysis details and timestamps.

AMD.description: Progressive retinal disease affecting central vision

DME.description: Fluid accumulation in the macula due to diabetes

Glaucoma.description: Optic nerve damage often associated with elevated intraocular pressure

DR.description: Retinal damage caused by diabetes complications

ERM.description: Fibrous tissue growth on the retinal surface

CRV/AO.description: Blockage of central retinal blood vessels

RNV.description: Abnormal new blood vessel growth in the retina
